sections.what: PPRM provides sexual and reproductive health services, including contraception, abortion, screening and testing. Its current region includes Colorado, New Mexico and Wyoming. It also provides education, outreach and advocacy for access to care.
sections.monitoring: The original FY2024 return reports over 56,000 clients across 21 Colorado, Nevada and New Mexico centers; 24% received abortion services. The model uses the lower-rounded 56,000 envelope, not a measured exact count or appointments. Current own giving information identifies Colorado, New Mexico and Wyoming. Clinic presence is not Denver residency: the 15% Denver-beneficiary share is a judgment with wide sensitivities, allowing other states and traveling patients. Monitor unique completed clients, local residence and actual additional gains and costs; contacts are not causal outcomes.
sections.qualitative: Original Turnaway studies followed patients receiving or being denied wanted abortions, with adjusted observational economic differences persisting four years and some physical-health differences after childbirth. They did not measure PPRM-specific provider additionality, a direct QALY gain or a precise after-tax dollar effect. Conditional hypotheses are 10% additional access, 0.02 maternal QALY over one year and $1,000 annual net household resources for four years after taxes, benefit withdrawals, childcare and ordinary work costs. Positive resource gains are halved for overlap; negative changes remain full. A $20 incremental time, travel and copay burden applies to all patient-household equivalents even when benefits fail. First-year benefits and costs share one log; later years are separate periods. No intrinsic welfare is assigned to unborn life or additional births, and no gross wage is substituted for net resources.
sections.cost: Full FY2024 expenses are $67,062,349 including netted direct fundraising costs; the three-full-year mean is $62,457,070. The whole regional numerator against abortion-only local benefits is a conditional partial-channel reference, not portfolio cost-effectiveness or a next-gift price. Contraception, STI care, screening, education and policy effects remain unquantified, not zero. Other providers, insurance, Medicaid, self-pay alternatives and public budgets constrain additionality. Provider and public-payer resource losses are tested separately; central zero is unmeasured, not proof of no cost. The official giving page identifies EIN 84-0404253 and routes to one-time or recurring support; no transaction was executed.
sections.funding: Three full-year original expenses are disclosed below. Current marginal donor capacity and restricted cost allocations remain unmeasured.

costScope: Full FY2024 regional organizational functional expenses plus netted direct event expenses. No verified abortion-channel allocation or marginal gift cost.
geography: Judged .15 Denver ten-county CBSA19740 resident share applied once to historical regional clients; no headquarters or clinic-site shortcut.
formula: Patient health = N × abortion share × completed access × provider additionality × finite utility, minus full all-patient harms. Resource households = N × unique-household judgment; changed households use same access gates. Net same-year gains/costs jointly logged; later gains separately discounted. Price = 10C/(health + signed household resource equivalent).
counterfactual: Other accessible reproductive providers, covered/self-pay care and patient-chosen fertility paths; not all patients otherwise denied abortion.
attribution: Provider additionality .1 is a judgment, separate from the clinical/economic effect of obtaining wanted care. Current donations do not automatically create equivalent new capacity.
uncertainty: Denver residence, access alternatives, marginal capacity, utility, net resources and omitted services remain uncertain.
native: Over 56,000 clients and 24% abortion-service share in the original FY2024 regional return; not exact unique households.
nativeUnit: lower-rounded annual regional client envelope, historical FY2024

inputRationales.C: Observed full FY2024 expense $66,931,878 plus $130,471 netted fundraising direct expenses.
inputRationales.N: Observed over 56,000 clients, rounded downward for reference; household uniqueness is separately judged.
inputRationales.eligible: Observed FY2024 24% abortion-service client share, not an observed health-success rate.
inputRationales.q: Explicit .02 one-year maternal QALY judgment, 7.3 healthy-day equivalents; original study measured self-reported outcomes, not utilities.
inputRationales.workGain: Judgment $1,000 annual net household resources after taxes, benefits, childcare and work costs, not gross wages or an empirical Turnaway dollar estimate.
